meta.rig: R6, default proportions: Torso 2x2x1, Head 2x1x1, arms/legs 1x2x1; HRP centre is 3 studs above the floor
meta.axes_hrp_frame: +X = character's right, +Y = up, -Z = forward (toward the target). Positions are studs relative to the HumanoidRootPart at frame 0.
meta.joint_rotation_convention: joints[J].euler_xyz_deg = [x, y, z] degrees applied as Rx(x)*Ry(y)*Rz(z) (Roblox CFrame.Angles order: Z first, then Y, then X), expressed in TORSO space and applied about the joint pivot by pre-multiplying the Motor6D's C0 rotation:  C0' = CFrame.new(C0.Position) * CFrame.Angles(x,y,z) * C0.Rotation  (this is exactly what src/ReplicatedStorage/Combat/Poses.lua does). Zero everywhere = default R6 rest pose.
meta.motor6d_transform: joints[J].transform_quat_xyzw / transform_euler_xyz_deg / transform_pos is the SAME pose expressed as a Motor6D.Transform (what an AnimationTrack / KeyframeSequence Pose stores): Part1 = Part0 * C0 * Transform * C1:Inverse(). transform_quat_xyzw is order-agnostic: CFrame.new(px,py,pz, qx,qy,qz,qw). Only the Root joint has a translation (transform_pos, in RootJoint space); it is how the torso sits relative to the HumanoidRootPart (torso_offset_hrp, in HRP axes).
meta.interpolation: Between keyframes: quaternion slerp of each joint with the easing named on the ARRIVING keyframe (ease_arriving); torso offset is lerped with the same alpha. baked_frames is exactly that, evaluated on every integer frame.
meta.foot_planting: Planted feet are solved with IK to fixed floor footprints; torso_offset_hrp.y already contains the stance height. Joint values therefore already include the leg IK; just play the joint data.
meta.markers: RightFist/LeftFist = centre of the arm's free end, RightFoot/LeftFoot = centre of the leg's free end, in world studs relative to the start HRP.
meta.format: R6 combat stance: enter / idle loop / exit / moving (upper body only), keyframes + every baked 60 fps frame
meta.stance_is_combo_ready_pose: STANCE_IDLE frame 0 is exactly the 'Ready' pose the M1 combo starts and ends in, so punches flow out of and back into the stance.
meta.loop: STANCE_IDLE and STANCE_MOVE loop: their last keyframe equals their first (validation.loop_seam_error ~ 0). Set KeyframeSequence.Loop = true for them.
meta.upper_body_only: STANCE_MOVE only contains Torso(rotation only)/Head/Arm poses and NO leg poses and NO torso translation: play it at Movement priority (above the default walk, below Action-priority attacks) while the walk animation keeps driving the legs. Legs in its pictures are shown at rest purely for context.
meta.foot_planting_note: For STANCE_ENTER / IDLE / EXIT the feet are IK-planted (see foot_planting); the torso sinks to the stance height (torso_offset_hrp.y) as the legs spread.

animations.name: Stance: draw in
animations.summary: Relaxed > coil down (anticipation) > snap the lead hand up > settle into the stance

keyframes.name: Relaxed
keyframes.note: Default relaxed standing pose (arms hanging, feet together).

keyframes.name: Dip
keyframes.note: Anticipation: feet spread wide, body drops and coils, both hands pulled in toward the body.

keyframes.name: Snap
keyframes.note: Overshoot: the lead hand snaps up past its final height, torso rises and twists into the blade.
cues: vfx: small dust puff at the feet (optional)

keyframes.name: Ready
keyframes.note: Settles into the stance (identical to STANCE_IDLE frame 0).

animations.name: Stance: idle loop (breathing)
animations.summary: Held stance with two breaths and a slow weight sway; loops every 3.2s

keyframes.name: Exhale
keyframes.note: The stance pose itself, chest lowered. First and last keyframe are identical so the loop is seamless.

keyframes.name: Inhale
keyframes.note: Chest rises, shoulders lift ~6 degrees, head lifts and drifts a touch to the right.

keyframes.name: Exhale (sway)
keyframes.note: Chest lowers; torso sways a little further into the blade, head drifts back left.

keyframes.name: Inhale (sway)
keyframes.note: Second breath; torso sways back the other way.

keyframes.name: Exhale
keyframes.note: Back to the exact first pose: loop point.

animations.name: Stance: relax
animations.summary: Stance > rise and loosen > relaxed standing pose

keyframes.name: Release
keyframes.note: Body rises, hands loosen and drop, feet draw back together.

animations.name: Stance: moving (upper body only)
animations.summary: Upper-body guard layered over the default walk/run legs; torso only turns slightly so legs don't skate

keyframes.name: Guard A
keyframes.note: Torso leans in and turns slightly (less than the idle stance), lead hand forward, rear hand back. No leg or torso-translation data: the walk animation keeps driving those.
cues: play at Movement priority while the character is moving

keyframes.name: Guard B
keyframes.note: Tiny bob so the upper body never freezes.

keyframes.name: Guard A
keyframes.note: Loop point: identical to the first keyframe.
